notes.title: Stormbridge joins Steam Next Fest! - Try the demo + New biome reveals!
notes.content: [p]Hi all![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a crazy year. Tomorrow the Storm grows. I am excited to announce that Stormbridge will be participating in the June 2025 Steam Next Fest live, starting tomorrow (June 9)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/1c8d226f751d30c9df6c302fe9c9d14ef1855d0d.png"][/img][/p][p]Stormbridge has a public demo which is already packed with hours of content, but I will be updating the demo to further add some new buildings and possibly even an epic building! Improvements such as resource metrics from the community have also been applied in the previous update.[/p][p]I will also write a devlogs showcasing the new maps (biomes) that will be in the full version of the game![/p][p]Meanwhile, here are some sneak peeks of the Sky Biome and the mysterious Underwater Biome![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/7eb31802b2ec9b490c1ed7eec553dc2865e2b7d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/e211bc9e56e0317637e4aa4a769c5d7ce6c351ad.jpg"][/img]  [/p][p]The full version will have four different maps to play on, each with its own unique mechanics and special missions.[/p][p]Some ideas are that each map drops unique meta currency, to help unlock certain upgrades related to that map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/2a59234c7912b5a0b6159a02659558ffa0b04eee.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Tundra Biome was previously teased in the previous [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3362750/view/535472473750110876"]devlog[/url] - penguins, blizzards, clothing and a new temperature mechanic are introduced in this map.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4b5a201d54c4ba5bf34757b0578cb5c401a0cb24.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hope you'll like it![/p][p]-YYZ[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4d457a882b6be767099711044cda6010e232626f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3362750/Stormbridge/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Cold Winds, Cozy Fires. Introducing the Tundra Biome!
notes.content:
Hi all!

I'm excited to give you a first look at the Tundra biome — the first of three new maps being added to Stormbridge!

You'll build across this frozen wasteland that's not just beautiful but brutal. 
And survival here means adapting...[i]fast[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/3219e4fd7a050871e0c0a904d75ffdf9c3a59390.jpg[/img]

[h1]Introducing The Tundra Biome[/h1]

After finding Faraday’s Lab at the edge of the sea, you board his boat....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/9351986f28b8a67f8229f48a5240aadf48fe82d7.gif[/img]

You begin your journey, sailing off across the pristine blue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/ee6fddcbe42cb366d2e7e1ce94cddf558bd4c5fe.gif[/img]

Soon, tropical sounds give way to a gentle hush, and the breeze turns crisp. 
Your breath starts to cloud softly in the air, and a shiver runs down your spine.

You are now stuck in the [i][b]tundra[/b][/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/819e4553e7936d69c8a80aae28a56ebaf5056896.gif[/img]

[h1]Survival Gets Real[/h1]

Fishing won't work, cranes have trouble poking through ice, and your electric burners can't burn as efficiently.

You'll need new strategies - old tricks don't work here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4b5a201d54c4ba5bf34757b0578cb5c401a0cb24.gif[/img]

How will you help your settlers to adapt?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/580fcf23d30e6daabeab2719d81eb728b1123310.gif[/img]

[h1] Cold-Weather Crops[/h1]
Tend to hardy new crops that shrug off frost and keep your settlers fed, even when the ground turns to ice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/833fb3685be6d6739cc4c74f46b2f3cf908b67ef.gif[/img]

[h1]Cozy New Shelters [/h1]
Unlock snug, warm buildings where your settlers can rest, recover, and escape the biting cold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/9e7dcb8e9107c24a8520de45b63df430356a36d6.gif[/img]

[h1]Cotton & Crafting[/h1]
Grow cotton and spin it into warm clothes — because a well-dressed settler is a healthy, happy one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/a6ab7e40e8b56e48e85cbf1d43d8bc0ce9eabc95.gif[/img]

[h1]Penguin Companions??[/h1]
Fishing may be gone, but not all hope is lost! These chilly companions can help you...but only if you can befriend them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/265eaf2001139d331c7341d96c4b05637988eb9b.gif[/img]

[h1]Survive the Blizzard![/h1]
The storm looks different here...

Introducing a fresh new threat - say goodbye to lightning and say hello the [b]ice lance[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/a758229adf9f351640a9bf1f09808e10a121e6d0.gif[/img]

[h1]The Air Engine Awaits[/h1]
Your tundra mission: uncover and build Faraday’s mysterious “Air Engine.”

But your only clue appears to be this blueprint... 
Can you decipher it in time to power through the cold?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/5e3de36f25e66bfdcd104e540b32b5882fba666d.gif[/img]



[h2]Got any ideas of what you want to see in the tundra? Lemme know your thoughts here or over on Discord![/h2]
[url=yyzstudio.com/discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4d457a882b6be767099711044cda6010e232626f.png[/img][/url]

-YYZ

notes.title: v0.80.1 - Rebalancing, improvements
notes.content:
Several improvements, rebalancing and settings have been added.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Cats' happiness boost reduced to 0.1x
[*] Trader now shows orange warning when trading for free
[*] Add eat teriyaki toggle in hunger bar hover panel
[*] Add screen shake toggle
[*] Add 'consumes charcoal' to cookhouse and smelter description
[*] Fix situations where certain tutorial rings on build menu do not show
[*] Fix first saved file on web not showing in menu till a refresh
[/list]

Teriyaki is needed for construction. But settlers sometimes eat it, preventing you from building what you want freely. A new toggle has been added. Now, you can [strike]starve[/strike] control the diet of your settlers if they eat too much Teriyaki!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/f47f69b644acc0eefebe93261d1cdd02e6ced542.png[/img]

It was not very clear that you had to select the coins to buy them, so a red message now shows when you don't do so.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4335789eb1669d8c6e4504c9e7045c85e7bfe249.png[/img]

Cats had to be nerfed as they trivialized happiness. Though, you can still get the same effect of the old level 1 cat in the full version by equipping three cats at max level. So hmm.

I would like to thank all of you who've played and given me feedback, and especially thank [b]Radian, Lavan and Jesus Cat[/b] for sharing incredibly useful feedback for me! This update was made possible thanks to them. I update this game every week so if you have feedback - you can leave them here on the Steam discussion forums, on our Stormbridge discord channel or to me directly @YYZ on Discord.

These are not the full list of changes I intend to make - I am progressively going to address the points raised - such as displaying better production counters to more accurately determine which resources you're producing/in need of. I haven't forgotten those, I just need some time to work on it.

Thank you for your support. :)

-YYZ

notes.title: v0.80.0 - Night bridge, Mac/Linux
notes.content:
v0.80 is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/a248d264b80e3e0dac79c8b4eb4cc6aefe971b87.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Add night version of main menu
[*] Experimental Mac and Linux builds
[*] Update localization and localization fixes
[*] Fix research panel item count not updating after claiming milestone rewards
[*] Fix tutorial screen pointers un-aligned
[/list]

[h2]Night bridge[/h2]

I love making beautiful scenery and as I was listening to some melancholic music while raining, I designed this scene!

I thought it was too pretty to leave out of the game, so I decided to integrate it into the main menu, which will now show this randomly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/5f75ef62adc134072fd8dab2c49677e430a26b82.jpg[/img]

I love making pretty environments so this was pretty relaxing and fun.

[h2]Mac and Linux experimental support[/h2]

Experimental Mac and Linux versions of the game have been added! Mac may not support advanced 3D graphics - therefore if you notice black squares on the water, go to settings > Disable water reflections.

These are experimental so they're not listed on the storepage for now. I'll do my best to support them. To help me help you, let me know what issues there may be if you try them so I know how stable they are.

[h2]Localization fixes[/h2]
Several text have been updated and I would like to thank all community translators for helping with the game's translation texts! If you'd like to help, you can join the discord to get in touch! And as usual, if you have feedback, leave them here or send them to me @YYZ on Discord if you want to share your ideas or chat! :)

notes.title: v0.79.0 - New trader blueprints!
notes.content:
v0.79.0 is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/fc09dd693e15de5409150302798cc39e26e4150e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Trader now sells Pharmacy blueprint
[*] Trader now sells Clinic blueprint
[*] Trader now sells Small Battery blueprint
[*] Small battery is now guaranteed from mid-tier cards after 290m
[*] Change top right UI buttons
[*] Add community translators to home island credits
[*] In Tundra, chick pets award miso instead of teriyaki
[*] Fix fastest time show 4.03 in level select screen
[*] Fix Small battery card not appearing after 290m
[/list]

To reduce reliance on RNG, the battery card will now have a very high chance to appear after 290m if it is not already unlocked.

Additionally, the trader now sells 3 new blueprints so you may purchase them to unlock essential buildings that you have not yet obtained.

I would also like to thank the community translators for helping out with the in-game translations. I've added your names to the home island and will continue to add more as the game goes - if you wish to help out, you can join the discord and go to the #translations channel!

[h1]Upcoming content[/h1]
In terms of content, I am working on a few new buildings as well. The medium battery and Epic battery will store more electricity than the small battery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/93caaf3abee78d63e6c72c19ce5f98a427291eec.jpg[/img]

A new resource will soon be added - Lithium, which are required to upgrade these batteries. Along with it, a new epic building, the Lithium Extractor, a plant that harvests Lithium from Iron ore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/2df5588f9e3f4fd482bcb1624b295b46f7483fa9.jpg[/img]

Thank you for playing Stormbridge and for your support! I will continue to push weekly updates to make improvements for you all. If you have any suggestions, drop them here, on Steam discussions or to me on Discord.

-YYZ

notes.content:
Chickens have been officially added to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/c23f2cc3d1d84ec7b70386d694ef5e5fa298cc10.jpg[/img]

Here is a preview of new pets being worked on! I will talk about them in a future post!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/622cac48b5f80d791998113fddd89f36a50fc242.jpg[/img]

The mother chicken will also soon be accompanied by chicks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/24b72e4f8d322b4be7e9bd9fc080e09eec46f029.jpg[/img]

With more pets being added to the game, better pet organization is required, so I added the ability to see all pets of a specific type, as well as level multiple pets without manually finding and selecting each one at the home island, saving tedious work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/0ace85121009abe74ff1a79e70b3dacd8aae6802.jpg[/img]

The maximum pet count will now also increase if you equip different pet types - this is to encourage using different pets, rather than spamming the same one. I think the game is more interesting that way. The default maximum has been decreased to 3, but the new maximum will be a lot higher once you gain access to more pets.

Quality of Life improvements and fixes have also been added. You can now unlearn researches to get back 100% of spent cost. This allows you to experiment with different builds as you progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/6ab7ed53c2c71e9868563268d9a8b7e39ba7aef3.jpg[/img]

Please continue to leave me feedback either here, on Steam discussions or on discord!

notes.title: v0.74.0 - Electric Cookhouse!
notes.content:
[h2]Electric Cookhouse[/h2]

Introducing a new building, the Electric Cookhouse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/cb3df7f67d0145f5c8f66a09cac45efca9fbdb1a.png[/img]

It is superior to the regular cookhouse. Not only is it faster, it does not require settlers or charcoal and consumes half water! It is sold as a premium blueprint by the trader.

[h2]New Trader research[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/fc39981ee188e61e07d9fb62290cfc0f644a9a3d.png[/img]

The trader research branch has been reorganized and now contains a new final research that grants the extraordinarily rare item: Circuits.

[h2]New Blueprints tab[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/dbe26adae009b0a8488c811072e31ede6b865b3a.png[/img]

Traders now sell two types of blueprints - Epic and Regular blueprints. As more blueprints are added, I dumped them all under 'epic' tab, but as the list grows, better and more accurate categorization is needed, so I have grouped them at the trader.

notes.title: v0.73.0 - Lollipop farms, fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/6d976575256001100a5cba0ddad41e9710860244.png[/img]

Here's a preview of the Home Island expansion! Once you unlock a land plot in the Home Island, you'll be able to build your own home as well as farms that give you additional resources once you complete a run (regardless of failure or success).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/1bf13f1c54143196252ad2aa548030045ab113ed.jpg[/img]

These resources can then be used to build more furniture on your home, or upgrade your pets! The lollipop farm gives lollipops that level up your pet abilities.

notes.title: v0.72.0 - Shiny Goldfish, Better farms
notes.content:
Introducing the shiny goldfish! At level 5, the goldfish will glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/e7a61a31754b73423e27796e9c302d69fd7664e8.png[/img]

Pets will be able to be fed and level up in future! The pet info box now shows the pet level and a star besides maxed level pets.

I added goldfish as a meme pet that gives a normal bonus effect, but I didn't realise that in a specific strategy, it actually becomes a powerful asset when fully leveled up. So I've decided to make it shine at max level. Other pets might change appearance at max level - I would personally love a purple turtle. (hey it rhymes!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/2914adfac9c2aa6d119856fe6a89bf8530be9efb.jpg[/img]

Veggie farms have also been buffed, and their description of feeding 3 settlers when they actually fed 1.5 was previously misleading - even though veggies do indeed restore 3x hunger, the farms producing them work twice as slow). However, in order to not make them weaker, in this new update, they now feed 2 people with the new durations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/205ae2149d2f2bd960d70f5509ec77719f574b6d.jpg[/img]

I've also made other fixes. Full changelog:

[*] Goldfish now glows at max level (Glowfish)
[*] Pet info now displays pet level
[*] Pet name displays star at max level
[*] Fix able to equip more pets than allowed when resetting research
[*] Fix achievement text at home island achievements incorrectly saying leaderboard

[/list]

notes.title: v0.71.0 - Trading improvements, optimizations
notes.content:
v0.71.0 is released, making changes to the trader.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/b88c3b97611a33bef47f4384d1d5759d6a439d80.jpg[/img]

I was watching [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40zkrjcLxpo]CG Plays[/url] play Stormbridge and noticed he got confused between 'Tooth' and 'Trading Token'. It also wasn't clear when you were giving away items and not getting anything back.

So firstly, I changed the name of the primary currency to 'Coin'.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/694cdfacf734b5f45fc86926b429f5395d133222.png[/img]

Secondly, the confirmation dialog shows you are giving away items for free if you did not select an item to buy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/1cade3cd6de56b9a0e0621c1534ad8a8d7d1d842.jpg[/img]

Thirdly, the row showing the coin glows a different colour from the rest and has an animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/9969f88fdc0a8ddd1cedf31b75b8d83bdf24d3d2.jpg[/img]

Lastly, 'Trading Token' will now only appear after visiting the Home Island, or on the second trade onward on the first run (past 200m).

Full patch notes:
[list]
[*] Change 'Tooth' to 'Coin'
[*] Add glow effect to coin's TradeRow
[*] Add 'for free' when giving away items
[*] Trader now only sells Trading Token after visiting Home Island

[/list]

notes.content:
I want the game to reward you EXP and items even when you lose against the first storm, so the game has been changed to give rewards even if you lose, I hope this encourages progression and makes it feel like you progress despite the outcome!

notes.title: v0.70.0 - Skill tree!
notes.content:
A skill tree has been added to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/c84b319ab66f74c6b509a28c3620f688db0d9789.jpg[/img]

Only the first skill is available in the demo at the moment, but there is a sneak peek of 7 other skills that will be in the full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4c8d0dfdd57518de0ce36588cbf9f0c1457e5863.png[/img]

As you complete runs, you gain EXP. When you level up, you'll gain skill points and be able to spend them on a brand new skill tree at the workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/e5118abc143edc5549fa98cec90cf2a3e28664fb.jpg[/img]

The skills have extremely high level caps, and can be upgraded almost infinitely compared to regular research.

In future, the skill tree can be expanded to give you mana regeneration and exciting spells you can cast. Some spells I have ideated are:

[list]
[*] Repair - MP-50, instantly repair the last X buildings destroyed by the storm
[*] Shield - MP-50, instantly add a shield to the nearest building
[*] Vehicle - MP-200, summon a vehicle
[*] Turbo Boost - MP-50, for 60 seconds, all building production speed x2
[*] Pushback - MP-100, push the storm back 50 meters
[/list]

The skill tree goes hand in hand with another system: Milestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333701/4ac877f764215bf803883ec0ba95d4e330a9db83.png[/img]

Milestones can give you skill points or item rewards, and they will be added in a subsequent update!

-YYZ
